warn.detail: UCI fold-1 alpha fitted on fold 0 is 0.40 while fold 2 fits 0.95; the resulting E_alpha on fold 1 is so poor that all four conditions gain about 96%. UCI's aggregate +91.8% therefore measures static-alpha instability, not gate quality. All four cells are within 0.1pp of each other there, so UCI contributes almost nothing to the factorial contrast.

P0L1 beats P1L1 on favorita (2.636 vs 2.478) and P1L0 beats it on freshretailnet (2.202 vs 1.366). The pre-registered primary candidate is reported as such, but the anchor is not what carries the improvement.
P1L1 mean |g - alpha| is 0.436 on UCI against P0L0's 0.357, so the anchored gate moves further from the static optimum than the neutral one there.

The multi-dataset report attributed the external failure to the regret target sitting at 0.5. That is refuted here: mean q tracks mean g*, corr(q,g*) is 0.84-0.86, and E_q < E_alpha in all four datasets. The target is well aligned; what fails is the fit, not the aim.
The frozen fold geometry gives three OOF folds, and expanding time leaves only two of them usable as validation, so every mean is over two points.
No existing TEST was scored with Gate-v3. The external failure result stands unchanged.
